findings.text: follow-on: handing the scan a request carrying the capability also changes the capability_class the live path passes to resolve_role_override, so every candidate's model/effort can be re-resolved through the class overlay for a live pick (previously ""); the commit body and manifest describe only the outcomes_at_requirement effect and no added test covers this candidate-construction change.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base eea36bacd2653c168105cd0282a51eb2aad7346a; 6e9a3a97b reorders the capability resolve before the scan and adds the snapshot_request, f7f51d1fb adds only the evidence fragment, all inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_a_live_pick_reads_outcomes_at_its_requirement.py and a no-added-failure comparison over the files importing reckon/crew/picker/__init__.py; the manifest records the gate at 4 passed EXIT=0 (independently re-run) but the importer comparison only over an 11-file change-relevant subset, not the full 62-file set.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to resolve the declared capability before the pick builds its candidates; reckon/crew/picker/__init__.py:405-418 moves the _declared_difficulty call ahead of the snapshotter and hands it a request carrying the resolved capability, so the goal lands.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it reports the gate 4 passed at negative_control_log logs/negative_control.txt (1 failed, EXIT=1), an 11-file importer subset with the same single pre-existing failure on both arms, and is honest that the 62-file importer sweep did not complete.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/crew/picker/__init__.py, tests/test_a_live_pick_reads_outcomes_at_its_requirement.py, docs/evidence/fragments/jev-learns-from-its-routes/a-live-pick-reads-outcomes-at-its-capability.html and a figures directory; the diff's three files are exactly the first three and no path outside them.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_live_pick_reads_outcomes_at_its_requirement.py:236-247 fails whenever the scan receives a capability-less request (the recorded negative control reinstates the old order and reddens it with KeyError), though the carried-capability assertion at :264 restates a value the test supplied at :261.
justifications.evidence: the manifest and logs/head_gate.txt record the gate 4 passed and logs/negative_control.txt reddens it, but the done_when's importer comparison was met only on an 11-file subset (logs/base_subset.txt and logs/head_subset.txt) rather than the 62-file importing set the done_when names.
justifications.fit: the reorder follows the module's own time.perf_counter/mark idiom at reckon/crew/picker/__init__.py:405-410 and uses dataclasses.replace; no plan, ticket or stage label appears in the code, comments or filenames.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/picker/__init__.py:405-421 resolves _declared_difficulty before snapshotter and passes snapshot_request carrying the resolved capability, and the state render at :449 keeps the same capability, so the block filters on the capability the state renders.
justifications.reuse: the change reuses the existing request.capability filter (_request_requirement at reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py:207) and stdlib replace rather than adding a mechanism, so it extends the owner of the capability filter and forks nothing.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff's three files (reckon/crew/picker/__init__.py, tests/test_a_live_pick_reads_outcomes_at_its_requirement.py, the evidence fragment) are exactly the product, test and fragment paths the manifest declares, with no figure and no path outside them.
